He placed the hair beneath the lamp, where the beam could touch it, and wrote an answer he would never send: “I heard you.”","w02":"凌晨四点，城市把喧闹折进黑暗。便利店的白灯照着空货架，夜班出租车滑过积水，尾灯像两点将熄的火。环卫工人的扫帚掠过路口，惊起一只避雨的麻雀。高楼里仍有零星窗亮着，有人赶稿，有人守病床，也有人只是睡不着。第一班地铁尚未出发，天桥上的风先吹来了清晨。豆浆铺掀开蒸笼，白雾慢慢升起，城市在无人留意时，悄悄换了一口气。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It must have a stopping point, like reaching the last box in a row of boxes.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding another box, and repeating until you find the prize; then you come back out, box by box."}
